answer: Price the attack by replication: one honest task costs 1 unit of compute, and a fake identity must reproduce it 3 times to survive a challenge. A single upheld challenge revokes the key and its harbor of invites. At 40 POA per unit, holding 100 keys for 10 epochs costs 120,000 POA against a reward pool that pays 9,000, so the cipher breaks on arithmetic and only relic accounts survive.
